title: Improved tactile speech robustness to background noise with a dual-path recurrent neural network noise-reduction method.
summary: A DPRNN with learned encoder, masking network and decoder reduced noise before tactile speech encoding; behavioral and objective human-subject evaluations are reported, and the quasi-causal model improved SI-SDR by 4.6 dB in stationary noise and 8.6 dB in multitalker noise. This supports a bounded speech-in-noise signal-processing result, not proven long-term hearing benefit. AI role: Dual-path recurrent neural network (DPRNN) noise reduction. The article appeared in Scientific Reports.
